chapterInfo.content:
17
Mmoa ho adesrɛ
Dawid mpaebɔ.
1O AWURADE, tie asɛntenenee, wɛn w’aso ma m’abooboo,
yɛ aso ma me mpaebɔ a ɛmfiri nnaadaa anofafa mu.
2 # Dwom 43.1 Ma bembuo mfiri w’anim mmra,
ma w’ani nhwɛ adeɛ a ɛtene mu.
3 # Dwom 16.7; 139.1 Sɛ wosɔ m’akoma hwɛ, na wohwehwɛ me mu anadwo,
na wonane me yiyi mu, worenhunu hwee.
Mabɔ me tirim sɛ meremma asɛmmɔne mfiri m’ano.
4Nnipa nneyɛɛ fam, w’anomu asɛm no nti
masɔre me ho, awerɛmfoɔ akwan ho.
5W’anammɔn no ara so na me kwan nam,
me nan anwati.
6Ao, Onyankopɔn, mesu mefrɛ wo, na wobɛgye me so.
Yɛ aso ma me, tie me nsɛm.
7 # Dwom 4.3 Fa anwanwa kwan so yi wo dɔ mapa adi kyerɛ,
wo a wogye wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ dwanekɔbea,
firi wɔn atamfoɔ nsam wɔ wo nifa.
8 # Deut 32.10 Hwɛ me so sɛ ani kurutuawisi,
fa me hunta wo ntaban nwunu ase,
9abɔnefoɔ a wɔfom me fa,
m’atamfoɔ atirimuɔdenfoɔ a wɔtwa me ho hyia no nti.
10Wɔapirim wɔn akoma a wɔnni mmɔborɔhunu biara,
wɔde wɔn ano kasa ahantan kasa.
11Wɔtetɛ me, na afei wɔtwa me ho hyia,
wɔde wɔn ani akari me pɛ m’asehweɛ.
12 # Dwom 10.9 Wɔte sɛ gyata a wɔredɛɛdɛɛ apɛ adufudeɛ,
te sɛ gyata ba a ɔtɛ kokoam.
13Ao, AWURADE, sɔre bɛsianka wɔn na brɛ wɔn ase,
fa w’afena gye me kra firi abɔnefoɔ nsam.
14 # Luka 16.25; Flp 3.19 AWURADE, fa wo nsa bɛgye me firi nnipa nsam,
nnipa a wɔn nkwa kyɛfa yɛ wiase deɛ,
fa deɛ wɔasiesie ama wɔn hyɛ wɔn yafunu ma;
ma wɔn mma nya no mmorosoɔ,
na wɔnnya bi mma wɔn mmotafowa.
15Me deɛ, mɛhwɛ w’anim tenenee mu,
menyane a, me ho bɛtɔ me sɛ mahu woɔ.

pageProps.chapterText:
O AWURADE, tie asɛntenenee, wɛn w’aso ma m’abooboo,
yɛ aso ma me mpaebɔ a ɛmfiri nnaadaa anofafa mu.
Ma bembuo mfiri w’anim mmra,
ma w’ani nhwɛ adeɛ a ɛtene mu.
Sɛ wosɔ m’akoma hwɛ, na wohwehwɛ me mu anadwo,
na wonane me yiyi mu, worenhunu hwee.
Mabɔ me tirim sɛ meremma asɛmmɔne mfiri m’ano.
Nnipa nneyɛɛ fam, w’anomu asɛm no nti
masɔre me ho, awerɛmfoɔ akwan ho.
W’anammɔn no ara so na me kwan nam,
me nan anwati.
Ao, Onyankopɔn, mesu mefrɛ wo, na wobɛgye me so.
Yɛ aso ma me, tie me nsɛm.
Fa anwanwa kwan so yi wo dɔ mapa adi kyerɛ,
wo a wogye wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ dwanekɔbea,
firi wɔn atamfoɔ nsam wɔ wo nifa.
Hwɛ me so sɛ ani kurutuawisi,
fa me hunta wo ntaban nwunu ase,
abɔnefoɔ a wɔfom me fa,
m’atamfoɔ atirimuɔdenfoɔ a wɔtwa me ho hyia no nti.
Wɔapirim wɔn akoma a wɔnni mmɔborɔhunu biara,
wɔde wɔn ano kasa ahantan kasa.
Wɔtetɛ me, na afei wɔtwa me ho hyia,
wɔde wɔn ani akari me pɛ m’asehweɛ.
Wɔte sɛ gyata a wɔredɛɛdɛɛ apɛ adufudeɛ,
te sɛ gyata ba a ɔtɛ kokoam.
Ao, AWURADE, sɔre bɛsianka wɔn na brɛ wɔn ase,
fa w’afena gye me kra firi abɔnefoɔ nsam.
AWURADE, fa wo nsa bɛgye me firi nnipa nsam,
nnipa a wɔn nkwa kyɛfa yɛ wiase deɛ,
fa deɛ wɔasiesie ama wɔn hyɛ wɔn yafunu ma;
ma wɔn mma nya no mmorosoɔ,
na wɔnnya bi mma wɔn mmotafowa.
Me deɛ, mɛhwɛ w’anim tenenee mu,
menyane a, me ho bɛtɔ me sɛ mahu woɔ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
